source_state: Frozen dirty snapshots with identical dependency sources. The candidate also contains a concurrent computation wrapper; the runner calls syntax parsing directly and never artifact registration. Measurement snapshots add a runner, a runner-only metrics feature, a SHA-256 dependency, and a layout probe.

environment.native_profiles: Rewrite: release, thin LTO, one codegen unit. Old: release, fat LTO, one codegen unit. Official: normal V8 JIT.
environment.allocation_profiles: Separate release targets with CountingAllocator; excluded from CPU measurements.

population.selection: Accepted inputs ordered by SHA-256 of absolute path; first 256, all accepted by official and old parsers. This is a deterministic selection, not a random sample.

cpu_note: Process counters include source loading, startup, and one warmup traversal for rewrite and official. Old has no separate warmup. Counts are divided by declared loop rounds. Main: 256 rounds, 12 samples per arm in ABBA order. Synthetic: 512 rounds, 8 samples per arm. Three arms: 64 rounds, 4 samples per arm in forward/reverse order. The host is shared and cores are not pinned. Cycle ranges overlap for the selected corpus. Background builds occurred; observed medians do not establish a globally fastest parser.
cache_note: Each sample performs one warmup traversal and three timed traversals. Four samples per arm and model. Cachegrind simulation includes startup. The 64-byte model is the collector default. The 128-byte model uses 192 KiB I1, 128 KiB D1 and 12 MiB LL; 3/8/12 ways are assumptions. Cachegrind is not a hardware measurement.

hardware_cache.reason: A real perf probe with CAP_PERFMON reports all six PMU events as not supported by the Linux VM. macOS proc_pid_rusage supplies CPU cycles and instructions, not cache misses.

allocation_note: Three measured traversals after one warmup. Pooled and pool-disabled runs are separate. Peak live growth is above the level where global allocation tracking starts; it is not total process heap.
rss_note: Two process samples per arm in ABBA order, 64 rounds. RSS includes loader and resident input sources; these four samples do not establish a stable memory reduction.
correctness_note: Full before/after Debug results agree for all corpus inputs, including errors. Official validation checks acceptance of the 256 selected inputs, not AST equivalence with our different surface tree.
